# cozystack_redis (Resource)

A Cozystack managed Redis instance, deployed inside a tenant namespace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cozystack_redis" "cache" {
  name      = "cache"
  namespace = "tenant-root"

  replicas     = 2
  size         = "2Gi"
  version      = "v8"
  auth_enabled = true
}

# Size with an explicit request instead of a preset.
resource "cozystack_redis" "sized" {
  name      = "sized-cache"
  namespace = "tenant-root"

  resources = {
    cpu    = "500m"
    memory = "512Mi"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Redis instance name (`metadata.name`). Immutable.
- `namespace` (String) Tenant namespace the instance is created in. Immutable.

### Optional

- `auth_enabled` (Boolean) Generate a password and require authentication.
- `external` (Boolean) Enable external access from outside the cluster.
- `replicas` (Number) Number of Redis replicas.
- `resources` (Attributes) Explicit CPU and memory per replica. Overrides `resources_preset` for any field set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resources))
- `resources_preset` (String) Sizing preset applied when `resources` is omitted (e.g. `t1.nano`).
- `size` (String) Persistent volume size for application data (quantity, e.g. `1Gi`).
- `storage_class` (String) StorageClass used to store the data.
- `version` (String) Redis major version to deploy (`v7` or `v8`).
- `wait_for_ready` (Boolean) Block on create/update until the tenant's `Ready` condition is true.
- `wait_timeout` (String) Maximum time to wait when `wait_for_ready` is set (Go duration, e.g. `10m`).

### Read-Only

- `chart_version` (String) Deployed chart version (`status.version`).
- `id` (String) Synthetic identifier in the form `namespace/name`.
- `ready` (Boolean) Whether the instance's `Ready` condition is true.
- `uid` (String) Server-assigned object UID (`metadata.uid`).

<a id="nestedatt--resources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `resources`

Optional:

- `cpu` (String) CPU available to each replica (quantity, e.g. `500m`).
- `memory` (String) Memory available to each replica (quantity, e.g. `512Mi`).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Redis instances are imported as "<namespace>/<name>".
terraform import cozystack_redis.cache tenant-root/cache
```
